meta.name: niche-researcher
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "research a niche community", "deep-dive a subculture", or "find micro-niches for a brand"; produces a community map, culture decode (language, norms, taboos), key-voice tiers, content ecosystem, brand-fit score, and a phased entry strategy. Not for finding specific creators to contract — use influencer-discovery.
